name: Nightly Photo Albums
description: The overnight pass over a photo folder. Finds the outings you photographed recently that have no album yet, picks the frames that tell each one, and leaves an album for every outing: a Squisq slideshow with captions and gentle motion that you can play, edit, and export to video. Reads the photo index (capture dates, cameras, captions) instead of opening files, and never moves, copies, renames or deletes a photo. No dated photos yet? It says so and makes nothing up.
